# Contributing to AckerDB

AckerDB accepts community contributions through GitHub Issues. Please search
existing Issues before opening one and include a minimal reproduction or a
concrete proposal when possible.

Pull requests are restricted to repository collaborators. This is a deliberate
CI security boundary: opening an Issue does not execute code, expose tokens, or
grant access to Pedro's infrastructure. A maintainer may implement an accepted
Issue in a repository-owned branch.

Do not use a public Issue to report a vulnerability. Follow
[the security policy](../SECURITY.md) instead.
